The composition is assembled, but the Arabic text does not render correctly, so I can't call it successful. The screenshots show the glyphs shaped and joined, but the RTL ordering is wrong.

**Composition:** <target compositionId="26d3774a-d99b-4063-8bf4-49e967e2c572" targetType="composition" targetId="26d3774a-d99b-4063-8bf4-49e967e2c572">LEAN_DAY24_SYSTEM_PILOT_20261015</target>
- UUID: 26d3774a-d99b-4063-8bf4-49e967e2c572
- Duration: 41.743673 s, from the narration track.
- Dimensions and frame rate: 1920x1080 landscape, 30 fps.
- P1_DAY24_41s_Rough and its publish were not touched. Nothing was published or exported.
- No new media, voice, web search or stock was used.

**Edits completed**
- **Narration:** Narration_TEMP_AR.mp3 is inserted unchanged as the script track at full gain. It is not trimmed or ducked, and no clips overlap it. I did not mark it as temporary pilot narration anywhere in the project.
- **Scenes:** Seven scenes with boundaries at 0, 5, 10, 17, 25, 31 and 36 s.
- **Transitions:** A 0.4 s crossfade is applied to every scene's head, including the first. I did not check how the first one looks.
- **0–5 s:** F1_Hero with the editable Arabic question on a semi-opaque ivory panel, with cobalt text. The image scales slowly and the text fades and rises in.
- **5–10 s:** F4_Diagram with an editable overlay "12 ساعة نهار + 12 ساعة ليل" on a cobalt band, plus a slow scale.
- **10–17 s:** F2_Macro with a slow scale and a small pan.
- **17–25 s:** E03_Met_Bakenrenef_PublicDomain at its native 1200x800, unscaled and unrestyled, inside an ivory mount on cobalt. The editable credit "The Met — 11.150.50b1 — Public Domain" sits below it. Both fade in.
- **25–31 s:** F4_Diagram with an editable "ساعات غير متساوية" on a cobalt band, with a slow scale.
- **31–36 s:** An ivory field with an editable "لاحقًا: ساعات متساوية", fading and scaling in. I used the ivory field instead of F5_Cutout.
- **36–41.74 s:** F6_Reset with an editable "نظام تشكّل خطوةً بعد خطوة" on an ivory band, with a slow scale and a text fade.
- **Music:** The Kevin MacLeod "Ambiment" bed (CC BY 3.0) runs the full length at gain 0.04, which is about -28 dB nominal. The track name carries the attribution. I added no separate project note and no on-screen credit.
- **SFX:** SFX_Paper_Groove at 5 s, SFX_Archive_Place at 17 s and SFX_Paper_Fold at 36 s, each at gain 0.25.

**Limitations and problems**
- **Arabic RTL is wrong.** The renderer lays the text out in the wrong order.
  - The 0–5 s question wraps into scrambled order.
  - In the 5–10 s overlay the 12s and the day/night words are in the wrong sequence.
  - The colon in the 31–36 s text sits on the wrong side.
- I used Noto Sans for the Arabic. I don't know whether it is the best available Arabic font, and a different font would not fix the ordering.
- **Not verified:** I took screenshots at 3, 8, 21 and 33 s only. I did not check the 25–31 s and 36–41.74 s Arabic text. I also did not check the 10–17 s pan or the transitions in motion.
- **Music fades:** None are applied, so the bed starts and stops abruptly.
- **Ducking and levels:** There is no ducking. I did not measure how the music and SFX sit against the voice.
- **Hard guarantees:** Native animation and dissolves are in, but I have not played them back to confirm the result.

**Export and measurement**
- I have no tool that reports whether native export is watermark-free at 1080p, or that measures LUFS or true peak.
- I did not export, so there is no measured output and no quality pass.

I stopped after this one assembly, as instructed.
